program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((centers (filter
                    (lambda (rc)
                      (let* ((r (fst rc)) (c (snd rc)) (h (rows g)) (w (cols g)))
                        (and (in-bounds? (- r 1) c h w)
                             (in-bounds? (+ r 1) c h w)
                             (in-bounds? r (- c 1) h w)
                             (in-bounds? r (+ c 1) h w)
                             (= 3 (at g (- r 1) c))
                             (= 3 (at g (+ r 1) c))
                             (= 3 (at g r (- c 1)))
                             (= 3 (at g r (+ c 1))))))
                    (find-color g 3)))
         (n (length centers))
         (pairs (flatmap
                  (lambda (i)
                    (map (lambda (j) (list (nth centers i) (nth centers j)))
                         (range (+ i 1) n)))
                  (range 0 n))))
    (foldl
      (lambda (pr acc)
        (let* ((a (first pr)) (b (second pr))
               (ar (fst a)) (ac (snd a))
               (br (fst b)) (bc (snd b))
               (dr (- br ar)) (dc (- bc ac)))
          (if (and (!= dr 0) (= (abs dr) (abs dc)))
              (let ((sr (if (> dr 0) 1 -1))
                    (sc (if (> dc 0) 1 -1)))
                (foldl
                  (lambda (k a2)
                    (let ((r (+ ar (* k sr))) (c (+ ac (* k sc))))
                      (if (zero? (at a2 r c)) (set-cell a2 r c 2) a2)))
                  acc
                  (range 1 (abs dr))))
              acc)))
      g
      pairs))))
